race.description: Illawarra Production Services C,G&E Mdn Hcp
race.comment: RAIN DELAY (2) comes from a stable who often target these sort of races in this area with their maidens. He has raced on the speed both times and come in second. Probably pushes forward here and attempts the same procedure. NONNO'S POWER (12) got too far back at Hawkesbury. He could well try to sit much closer here. CAPTAIN PEACOCK (5) was back in journey three weeks ago when resuming but on breeding alone he wants more ground. SMASHING MACHINE (8) has shown enough at the trials to suggest he can make his presence felt on debut.
